episodes.name: The Easter Bunnies
episodes.overview: The Easter Bunny is sick, so she hires The Looney Builders to take over the festivities and ensure Looneyburg has a great Easter.

episodes.name: Junior
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Ma and Pa Bear to build a bedroom for their son, Junior, whose excitement causes setbacks.

episodes.name: Looney Moon
episodes.overview: When The Looney Builders help Wile E. Coyote build a telescope to view the Looney Moon, Tweety must face his fear of the dark.

episodes.name: Glamp Out
episodes.overview: Gossamer invites The Looney Builders on a camping trip. They plan to build a simple campsite until Daffy insists they go "glamping" instead.

episodes.name: Outer Space
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders build Marvin the Martian and his Martian crew a space station. Marvin soon becomes overwhelmed by his Martian crew's antics and lack of personal space.

episodes.name: The Great Flying Flea
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders discover Zippy, an acrobatic flea, living on Sylvester's back. They build Zippy a flea circus to try and convince him to relocate.

episodes.name: The Snuffles
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build an outdoor movie theater in the park. Lola is sick, but she doesn't want to admit it.

episodes.name: Rainy Day
episodes.overview: When it starts to rain outside, Porky hopes to show The Looney Builders that they can still have fun inside by building a fort.

episodes.name: Bugs and the Beanstalk
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders build a castle for Elmer the Giant. They admire his toys and use them without his permission.

episodes.name: Jazz Hooves
episodes.overview: Fosse Ferret hires The Looney Builders to build a stage for the kids’ dance recital. Eggbert has stage fright.

episodes.name: Looney Games
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Mayor Leghorn to build the venue for the Looney Games. They soon become overwhelmed by the job and must ask for help.

episodes.name: Roller Disco
episodes.overview: Pete Puma hires The Looney Builders to build a roller disco for Looneyburg. Lola is new to roller skating but doesn’t want to practice.

episodes.name: Grandpa Oink
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Petunia’s Grandpa Oink to upgrade his farm.

episodes.name: Hare Ball
episodes.overview: Marvin the Martian hires The Looney Builders to build an outer space ball court on Mars. Bugs is a big fan of the sport.

episodes.name: Squeaky Clean
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders build their headquarters a car wash. Daffy doesn’t want to wash Dumpy and goes to extreme lengths to keep him dirty.

episodes.name: Prize Worthy Birdie
episodes.overview: Sunny Seagull hires The Looney Builders to build a carnival on Looneyburg's pier.

episodes.name: Cake Bake
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders take turns distracting Petunia as they build her a big surprise birthday cake in the backyard.

episodes.name: Porky Perfect Parade
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders build a float to lead the Flower Parade, but Porky won't settle for anything less than Porky Perfect.

episodes.name: Coaster Contest
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a rollercoaster for Looneyburg.

episodes.name: Sam's Stylin Salon
episodes.overview: Sam Sheepdog hires The Looney Builders to build him a salon. Sam offers his custom cut only to learn that different folks want different styles.

episodes.name: Polar Plunge
episodes.overview: Pro snowboarder Pepper Polar Bear hires The Looney Builders to build a ski resort. Pepper soon learns that others have different skill levels.

episodes.name: This Sand is Your Sand
episodes.overview: Wile E. Coyote hires The Looney Builders to build him a house in the desert so he can be alone. The Road Runner tries to pay him a visit.

episodes.name: Fire Fighters
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by the town’s volunteer firefighters to build a fire truck.

episodes.name: Beignet Day
episodes.overview: Zaida Gator hires The Looney Builders to build her a boat so she can share her beignets in the swamp.

episodes.name: Pauleen's Pins
episodes.overview: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build an ice bowling alley in Looneyburg.

episodes.name: Coconut Hut
episodes.overview: While on vacation, The Looney Builders befriend Coco the Crab and offer to build her a mini-resort.

episodes.name: Balloon Voyage
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival.

episodes.name: Yosemite Sam's Dude Ranch⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.

episodes.name: Baseball Bunnies⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders build a baseball field, but both Bugs and Lola want to be the pitcher for the big game later.

episodes.name: ⁨Spellbound⁩
episodes.overview: Witch Hazel hires The Looney Builders to make her house look spooky for Halloween.

episodes.name: Miss Prissy's Market⁩
episodes.overview: Miss Prissy hires The Looney Builders to build a grocery store for Looneyburg.

episodes.name: Super Builders⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders play superheroes and decide to upgrade their vehicles and headquarters. However one of Wile E. Coyote's inventions goes rogue.

episodes.name: Dodo's Wacky Funhouse⁩
episodes.overview: Yoyo Dodo hires The Looney Builders to build a funhouse for Looneyburg. The crew thinks he's goofing around as they work.

episodes.name: Robo-Runner
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a festive course for the Fall foot race. Wile E. Coyote is determined to beat the Road Runner.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Cuckoo⁩
episodes.overview: Curt Cuckoo hires The Looney Builders to build a giant cuckoo clock in Germany to signal the start of Martinstag.

episodes.name: Surf's Up⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a surfside hangout in Australia for a surfing competition.

episodes.name: ⁨Mamma Mia Pizzeria⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Giovanna Badgerini to update her family’s pizzeria. However, Giovanna’s Mamma prefers the old way of doing things.

episodes.name: Carnaval⁩
episodes.overview: Carina Capybara hires The Looney Builders to build her Samba School a float for Brazil's Carnaval parade.

episodes.name: Puppet Showstopper⁩
episodes.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India.

episodes.name: Santa's Toyshop
episodes.overview: After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.
